statement: Within the preregistered Round-3 same-class rocksalt and perovskite scope, the frozen multiplicative correction improves a0 median absolute relative error; this is the active public correction scope.

premises.statement: The confirmatory Round-3 out-of-sample evidence covers a0 corrections calibrated leave-one-out within the same structure class.

lean_theorem.reason: No Lean theorem proves the empirical Round-3 a0 improvement; the available capped in-hull theorems require stronger Round-4 caps and explicitly do not retroactively license the frozen Round-3 rule.

excluded_scope: Structures and chemistries outside the Round-3 rocksalt and perovskite evaluation sets
